defects_repaired.description: HTF (5M/15M/1H/4H/1D) swing targets were previously checked for consumption only against closed candles of that same timeframe (or 1H for PDH/PDL), ignoring finer-grained closed LTF candles (1M/5M/15M) after the last HTF close.

Candidate M5/M15 structural stop anchors were previously checked for invalidation only against the 120-bar M1 window (last 2 hours), missing invalidations on closed M5/M15 bars between anchor formation and the start of the M1 window.

Both branches when not broke_on_or_before_stop previously assigned PREMATURE_NOISE_SWEEP_STOP, making DELAYED_INEVITABLE_LOSS unreachable (0 across all 9 variants) and conflating pure noise sweeps where outer structure held with premature wick sweeps where outer structure broke later.
